review_subject.purpose: LIVE-1 accepted behavior/runtime-control implementation delta + release-bound cold-control registry + hostile qualification corpus + semantic responsibility audit

release_bound_owner_rule: CONTROL_LOAD may activate only owners/digests bound by this control cut. Material owner drift creates a new control cut and invalidates inherited global behavioral qualification until affected requalification.
quarantine_rule: Restored/cached control bodies remain QUARANTINED_EVIDENCE until release-bound CONTROL_LOAD/live revalidation admits the active owner.
qualification_rule: Q-COLD and Q-RECOVER are distinct required subjects when both modes are supported; Q-STALE is hostile recovery fixture; Q-OLDCHAT is compatibility observation only.

source_rollback_subject.note: This source baseline is not a claim that exact live Project Settings/files can be restored from Git alone. Final cutover requires exact C0 capture/readback or explicit Patrick risk acceptance.

next_gate: One implementation review of this immutable R4 subject. Material changes after review begin create R5/new subject. Only after review convergence may native/full owner + final source manifest/checksums be mechanically composed as an installable candidate.
root_trust_note: Git blob SHA binds exact bytes for this source-review subject. Final installable candidate must generate required SHA-256 release/root-trust bindings; this R4 review subject intentionally does not pretend those final install artifacts exist.
